description: Return the latest spot (or GC futures) price for one symbol. Optional currency (ISO 4217, e.g. EUR) prices a bare symbol in that currency: symbol XAU with currency EUR is XAU-EUR-SPOT. Omit currency for USD. A full symbol such as XAU-EUR-SPOT also works without it. Price is a Decimal-formatted string. Latest USD spot price (and copper bid/ask) use nearest half-up rounding: XAU 2 decimal places, XAG 3, HG 4. Gold and silver quotes carry a single price, so their bid and ask are null. Free and keyless callers get the price 15 minutes late; copper bid/ask are null when no quote is available. `is_stale` is true when aggregator detected source divergence or stale FX.
name: get_spot_price
title: Get Spot Price
